notes.title: 🆕 V0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]The V0.6 update introduces a new feature and several important bug fixes:[/p][h3]✨ New Feature[/h3][list][*][p][b]Crosshair Cursor Smoothing[/b]: When using external light gun hardware, the crosshair could jitter due to excessive sensitivity. A smoothing system has now been added to improve stability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoothing Adjustment[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Press [b],[/b] to increase smoothing for more stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Press [b].[/b] to decrease smoothing for higher precision when using a mouse.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]spiders could get stuck at the cave exit respawn point[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]reload sound could not be stopped[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]some fonts were not displaying correctly[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🛠 Update Notes | Patch Released
notes.notes:
[h2]🛠 Update Notes | Patch Released[/h2][p]Agents, thank you for your support and feedback!
We’ve just rolled out a small update that addresses the following issues:[/p][list][*][p]🌐 [b]Language Setting Fix[/b]: The game now correctly detects and uses your default language.[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 [b]Achievement Fix[/b]: Resolved an issue where certain achievements could not be unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]: Fixed several minor bugs and improved overall stability.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep sharing your feedback in the community — we’ll continue polishing the game to bring you a better experience![/p]
